meta.title: Lba Rda And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer item to the public hearing on June 6, 2023 (LBA Resolution: Budget for the Capital Projects Fund for Fiscal Year 2023-24)
votes.description: The LBA board closed the first public hearing on the FY2023-24 Capital Projects Fund budget, which covers bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries, and referred it to the June 6 public hearing.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the LBA and convene as the RDA
votes.description: Procedural motion to end the Local Building Authority meeting and reconvene as the Redevelopment Agency board.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer item to the public hearing on June 6, 2023 (RDA Resolution: Budget for the Redevelopment Agency for Fiscal Year 2023-24)
votes.description: The RDA board closed the first public hearing on the FY2023-24 RDA budget and referred it to the June 6 public hearing.

votes.motion: Adjourn as the RDA and convene as the City Council
votes.description: Procedural motion to end the Redevelopment Agency meeting and reconvene as the Salt Lake City Council.

votes.motion: Approve formal meeting minutes of February 21, 2023
votes.description: The Council approved the official formal meeting minutes from the February 21, 2023 meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 15 of 2023, celebrating June 2023 as Pride Month
votes.description: The Council adopted a joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing June 2023 as Pride Month in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on items G1-G10 to a future Council meeting
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing covering the Early Notification Text Amendment and nine grant applications, deferring action on all items to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer items G11-G22 to the public hearing on June 6, 2023
votes.description: The Council closed the first public hearing on budget-related ordinances for FY2023-24 (Library Fund, City Budget, tax levy, fee schedule, compensation plans, union MOUs, and other code amendments) and referred them to the June 6 public hearing.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 21 of 2023 amending the FY2023 final budget of Salt Lake City including the employment staffing documents for specified items only (Budget Amendment No. 6)
votes.description: The Council partially adopted the FY2022-23 Budget Amendment No. 6, approving funding for items including mobile clean team services, homeless services, natural gas cost increases, an environmental assessment, ARPA revenue replacement for RDA's Westside Community Initiative, and a state homeless shelter cities mitigation grant revision.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 16 of 2023 for the airport revenue bond and recognize the date set for a public hearing scheduled June 6, 2023
votes.description: The Council approved a parameters resolution authorizing the issuance and sale of up to $600,000,000 in Airport Revenue Bonds Series 2023 to finance capital improvements to Salt Lake City International Airport.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 22 of 2023 approving a $350,000 loan for Trackland, LLC from the Economic Development Loan Fund
votes.description: The Council approved a $350,000 Economic Development Revolving Loan Fund loan to Trackland, LLC, a Sugar House-based software company, to support job creation and retention.
The Council approved the consent agenda including setting public hearing dates, grant holding account items, board appointments, and board reappointments to the Sister Cities Board.
